newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER PERNILLA WIBERG.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER PERNILLA WIBERG.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of the World Cup Finals women's downhill race on Wednesday:
World Cup wins: 20; 13 slaloms, 1 giant slalom, 3 Super-G, 1

Wiberg, winner of four slalom and two Super-G races entering the World Cup Finals this season had already clinched the overall championship, becoming the first Scandinavian woman to win the crown. She captured her first career downhill at the Finals to become the only active woman skier to own wins in all four World Cup disciplines. Wiberg won Olympic gold in 1992 in the giant slalom and in 1994 in the combined. She won world championship gold in the giant slalom in 1991 and the 1996 world title in combined.
